name: hashicorp-vault-kv
label: HashiCorp Vault KV
description: HashiCorp Vault KV v2 secrets engine connector. Reads, writes, lists and deletes key-value secrets through the KV version 2 mount, using token authentication. Unlike the official read-only hashicorp-vault connector, this connector can WRITE: write_secret creates a new version of a secret, so scheduled rotation flows can push fresh credentials into Vault and let downstream watchers pick up the new version. Operations: read secret (optionally a specific version), write secret, update only some fields of a secret (PATCH), list secrets under a path, delete the latest version of a secret, read and update a secret's custom metadata, and find the secrets under a path whose custom metadata carries a tag - without reading any secret value, so a rotation flow can run with a token that may update secrets but never read them.

fields.name: server
fields.title: Server URL
fields.description: Base URL of the HashiCorp Vault server, for example http://10.0.0.1:8200.

fields.name: token
fields.title: Token
fields.description: Vault token used for authentication. Grant only what your playbooks use: read/list on metadata and patch on data is enough to find tagged secrets and update them without being able to read them.

fields.name: mount
fields.title: KV v2 Mount Path
fields.description: Mount path of the KV version 2 secrets engine. Default: secret.

fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate of the Vault server is to be verified. Uncheck for self-signed certificates.

fields.name: timeout
fields.title: Request Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Per-request timeout in seconds applied to every Vault HTTP call.

operations.title: Get Health
operations.description: Verify connectivity and token validity against Vault by looking up the token itself (auth/token/lookup-self).

operations.title: Read Secret
operations.description: Read a secret from the KV v2 mount. Optionally read a specific (historic) version; by default the latest version is returned. The result includes the secret's data, the version number and the metadata.

parameters.title: Secret Path
parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the secret under the mount, without the leading mount name (e.g. myapp/api for secret/myapp/api).

parameters.title: Version
parameters.name: version
parameters.description: (Optional) Read this historic version instead of the latest one.

operations.title: Write Secret
operations.description: Write a secret to the KV v2 mount. This creates a NEW VERSION of the secret (existing fields are not merged, so include every field you want kept). Downstream consumers watching version changes will observe the bump. Returns the new version number.

parameters.title: Secret Path
parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the secret under the mount.

parameters.title: Secret Data (JSON)
parameters.name: secret_data
parameters.description: JSON object with all fields of the secret. Every existing field you omit is dropped by the versioning semantics - resend fields you want kept.

parameters.title: Create Only
parameters.name: create_only
parameters.description: Refuse the write if a secret already exists at the path (Vault check-and-set 0), so a new secret never overwrites one.

operations.title: Update Secret Fields
operations.description: Change only the given fields of an existing secret, keeping every other field (an HTTP PATCH, which creates a new version). Needs only the patch capability on the data path - not read. Retried on network errors and server errors; a refused policy (403) or a missing secret (404) is not retried.

parameters.title: Secret Path
parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of an existing secret under the mount.

parameters.title: Fields (JSON)
parameters.name: secret_data
parameters.description: JSON object of only the fields to change. Fields you leave out keep their current values.

parameters.title: Retries
parameters.name: retries
parameters.description: (Optional) Extra attempts after a network or server error. Default 3, at most 10.

operations.title: Get Secret Metadata
operations.description: Read a secret's metadata: its custom metadata tags, current version and whether that version is deleted. Never returns the secret's value.

parameters.title: Secret Path
parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the secret under the mount.

parameters.title: Missing Is OK
parameters.name: missing_ok
parameters.description: Answer exists=false for a path with no secret, instead of failing.

operations.title: Update Secret Metadata
operations.description: Add or change custom metadata tags on a secret, keeping its other tags. Set a tag to null to remove it. Values are stored as text. Does not create a new secret version.

parameters.title: Secret Path
parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the secret under the mount.

parameters.title: Custom Metadata (JSON)
parameters.name: custom_metadata
parameters.description: JSON object of tags to set, for example {"faig_key_id": "<uuid>"}. A null value removes that tag.

operations.title: Find Secrets by Metadata
operations.description: Find the secrets under a path whose custom metadata carries a tag, and its value. Vault cannot search, so this lists every secret under the path (including sub-folders) and reads each one's metadata - never a secret value. A secret whose latest version is deleted does not count. Given values, sorts each into matches (exactly one secret), unmatched (none) and conflicts (more than one).

parameters.title: Path
parameters.name: path
parameters.description: (Optional) Folder to search, including its sub-folders. Empty searches the whole mount.

parameters.title: Metadata Key
parameters.name: metadata_key
parameters.description: Custom metadata tag to look for.

parameters.title: Values
parameters.name: values
parameters.description: (Optional) Tag values to look up, as a JSON array or comma-separated text. Adds matches, unmatched and conflicts to the result.

parameters.title: Max Secrets
parameters.name: max_paths
parameters.description: (Optional) Stop with an error past this many secrets, so a wrong path cannot walk the whole mount. Default 1000.

operations.title: List Secrets
operations.description: List the secret keys under a path in the KV v2 mount.

parameters.title: Path
parameters.name: path
parameters.description: (Optional) List keys under this path. Empty lists keys directly under the mount root.

operations.title: Delete Secret Version
operations.description: Soft-delete the latest version of a secret in the KV v2 mount. Earlier versions remain readable by version number.

parameters.title: Secret Path
parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the secret under the mount.

operations.title: Execute API Request
operations.description: Calls any Vault HTTP API endpoint with the configured token. A full URL is refused so the token only ever goes to the configured server.

parameters.title: Endpoint
parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: Path on the Vault server, for example /v1/sys/health or /v1/secret/data/myapp. /v1 is added when missing.

parameters.title: Method
parameters.name: method
parameters.description: HTTP method. Defaults to GET. LIST is Vault's list verb.

parameters.title: Query Parameters
parameters.name: query_params
parameters.description: (Optional) JSON object of query string parameters.

parameters.title: Request Body
parameters.name: request_body
parameters.description: (Optional) JSON object sent with POST, PUT and PATCH.
